name: Discover Personal Loans
notes: Researched from the public discover.com personal loan FAQ only (no sign-in). Sign-in to the Account Center uses a User ID and password (Forgot User ID/Password; Register Account); Discover Card credentials may differ. The Automatic Payment program is free and draws the scheduled monthly payment from checking or savings, with larger amounts allowed. The FAQ states the loan has no fees of any kind (no origination or prepayment fees), so bank payments are free. Due date can be changed in the Account Center to any day from the 2nd to the 27th, twice over the loan with 12 months between changes. Repayment assistance is by phone (1-877-256-2660), so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Statements are mailed about 20 days before the due date; paperless enrollment is in the Account Center. Card payments are not described (bank-only).

autopay.note: The Automatic Payment program is free; choose Payments in the Account Center to enroll.

payment_arrangement.note: Repayment assistance is arranged by phone. Call 1-877-256-2660 (TDD 1-866-710-3357) to discuss temporary or long-term hardship programs.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay in the Discover app or the Account Center (payments take effect on the date you schedule), enroll in Automatic Payments, pay by phone through the automated system or a representative, use your bank's bill pay, send a wire, or mail a payment.
Discover personal loans have no origination fee and no prepayment penalty. Extra payments go first to accrued unpaid interest, then to principal.

help.title: Automatic Payments
paragraphs: The Automatic Payment program is free. It withdraws your scheduled monthly payment from your checking or savings account, and you can set a larger amount to pay the loan off sooner. To enroll at any time, log in to the Account Center, choose Payments and follow the prompts.

help.title: Changing your due date
paragraphs: Change your due date in the Account Center or by calling 1-877-256-2632. You can pick any day from the 2nd to the 27th of the month, up to twice over the life of the loan with at least 12 months between changes.

help.title: Repayment assistance
paragraphs: If you have a temporary setback or a long-term hardship, call 1-877-256-2660 (TDD 1-866-710-3357) to learn about repayment assistance programs.

help.title: Logging in
paragraphs: Log in to the Account Center with your User ID and password. If you don't have one yet, choose Register Account; if you forgot it, use Forgot User ID/Password. If you also have a Discover Card, its login may be different.

extra.intent: Using the Discover Personal Loans FAQ, find the phone number for changing your loan due date. Do not change any settings.
Using the Discover Personal Loans FAQ, find the latest day of the month you can choose as a new due date. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Any day from the 2nd to the 27th, so the 27th is the latest.
